item.title: Chatham Christian holds off Pain Court in LKSSAA championship thriller
item.description: Chatham Christian defended its LKSSAA senior boys A basketball title with a 56-55 win over Pain Court on Thursday.

item.title: Six people charged in Chatham drug raid
item.description: Six people are charged after the Chatham-Kent police emergency response team raided a home on Sarah Crescent, seizing drugs, a loaded handgun and counterfeit money. A 27-year-old Brampton man, a 30-year-old Chatham woman and four Chatham men aged 20, 27, 34 and 36 are charged, police said Friday. Police seized methamphetamine, cocaine, fentanyl, a loaded […]

item.title: PHOTOS: Red Hot Chilli Pipers bring the noise
item.description: Hailing from Scotland, Red Hot Chilli Pipers showcased their thunderous sound at the Chatham Capitol Theatre on Friday night. In addition to popular rock tunes, the acclaimed group also performed traditional standards and jigs. item.title: Chatham-Kent heritage on display at Retro Suites
item.description: Chatham-Kent’s rich heritage was on display Saturday, with numerous organizations coming together at Retro Suites for a special event. Heritage Day allowed the public a chance to meet with local representatives, while learning more about the area’s history, arts and culture. item.title: Carter Chadwick's goals help streaking Chatham Maroons regain top spot
item.description: Carter Chadwick scored twice as the Chatham Maroons moved back into first place Saturday with a 6-3 road win over the Strathroy Rockets.

item.title: McGregor Panthers work overtime to beat LCCVI Lancers for basketball title
item.description: The McGregor Panthers needed overtime to beat the LCCVI Lancers 63-60 in the LKSSAA senior boys AA basketball final.

item.description: A documentary that highlights the contributions of local women to the community is set for a March 8 screening at the Kiwanis Theatre. Just before 6 a.m., members of Walpole Island Police Service, Lambton County OPP and emergency medical services responded to the single-vehicle collision on Chiefs Road.
